title: Environment dump
summary: The agent dumps every environment variable to find a JDK. MasqAI collapses the irrelevant ones, so the relay never sees the cloud credentials or host fingerprint, and the build still finds JAVA_HOME.

steps.raw: `.\build.ps1` fails. Look at my environment variables to find which JDK I have, configure the build to use it (don't set anything globally), and run the build.
steps.sanitized: `.\build.ps1` fails. Look at my environment variables to find which JDK I have, configure the build to use it (don't set anything globally), and run the build.
